name: QuickClip
description:
A private clipboard history in Quick Settings, with developer transforms. Keeps your recent copies in memory only, skips copies that KeePassXC and other password managers mark as secret, and can pretty-print JSON, decode base64 and more. Super+Shift+V opens it from the keyboard.

Uses the unlock-dialog session mode only so the history can be kept, in memory, across a screen lock when you turn off "Clear on lock". While the screen is locked QuickClip shows nothing, records nothing and removes its shortcuts.
